name: Museum Assistants (Teen Assistants)
what_you_do: Teens from the St. Louis area learn about art and teach others about art from around the world.
who_can_apply: Teens from the St. Louis area. Age range not stated on the page.
duration: Up to 24 hours a week in summer. At least 5 hours a month in the school year.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Use the Learn more and apply link on the museum's teen assistants page. A contact email is listed there.
